title: Table Cardinality
description: The number of rows per table, the foundation every other estimate builds on. Recorded facts — Component: Table Cardinality; Estimates: row counts; Unit: rows. Used by database engineers tuning optimizers and by developers understanding slow queries.
demo:
# Table Cardinality — runnable demo (python3)
# Table Cardinality - cost estimate (python3)
rows=1000000
sel=0.1
cost_per_1k=2.5
est_rows=rows*sel
cost=est_rows/1000.0*cost_per_1k
print("estimated rows: %.0f, estimated cost: %.1f" % (est_rows, cost))
